Container.Name: Soloblog
Container.Overview: Soloblog is a free, open source blog and website for one person, run on your own server or hosting account. Write in a calm editor, pick from 35 colour palettes, and build pages from sections. Your posts are plain text files you own. Readers can comment, subscribe by email or follow from Mastodon, and members-only posts can be free or paid. Everything is kept in one folder, with backups built in.[br][br]First-time setup asks for a setup token: select Soloblog's icon in the Docker tab, then Logs, and copy it from the lines marked [setup].

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: The port the site opens on

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Posts, images, the database and settings - everything the site keeps

Config.Name: Site URL
Config.Description: Your site's public URL, such as https://blog.example.com. Left empty, the site uses the URL you open setup at, and Settings can change it.

Config.Name: Platform
Config.Description: Lets first-time setup say where Unraid shows the setup token
